title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Ice #168 Wesley Matthews Milwaukee Bucks Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm sports trading card is a must-have for any basketball fan! Featuring Wesley Matthews of the Milwaukee Bucks, this card is from the Pink Ice parallel/variety set and is numbered 168. It is an excellent addition to any sports trading card collection and comes from the highly sought-after 2020-21 Prizm set.

The card is autograph-free and has no mention of its condition. It is made by Panini, a trusted manufacturer of sports trading cards. This National Basketball Association (NBA) card is perfect for fans of the Milwaukee Bucks or collectors of trading cards from the 2020-21 season. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this card to your collection!
